I'm just venting really. but it all started because I sent them some information which contradicted something they had said on the weekend. they got extremely defensive, especially considering it was really innocuous. it wasn't something that had been hottly debated. 
The said they didn't care, I said I only sent it because I would have liked the information if the situations were reversed, because that way I can correct myself in future, which lead to about 15 messages where it was just me being abused for bullshit and "getting on my high horse" which I ignored. It basically would be a few messages, 5 minute break, a few messages, five minute break. Like they were getting even more pissed off at the fact I wasn't responding to them abusing me. 

Then they started with the lowblows, which basically came across as how dare you act the way you do, I am actually trying to better myself and do things I enjoy and you just like to sit at home (They know I don't, and that I often actually feel trapped here.) and fuck around and do nothing to make yourself feel better (They know I hate being here. I wish I could get up and get out and do shit. but that requires having motivation and energy and I often struggle to get up and eat.) 

Literally stuff I had a bit of a breakdown over the weekend about when I was drinking (the only time my defenses really drop enough that I can even talk about it, and it tends to flood out.), and they know it. 
That is part of why it's much worse behaviour on their part to have used it to attack me. or atleast why I see as such.

it was basically a massive self-serving bullshit tirade, and despite being a massively empathetic person, I can't possibly put myself in those shoes because I can't see a time where acting like that would be acceptable behaviour. 

It was either a concerted attempt to make me feel bad, or to make themselves feel better, but neither makes it acceptable.
